subject: Consolidated billing & PO reference requirements — next steps
messages:
From: Kyle Morgan <kyle.morgan@bluepeak.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: procurement@bluepeak.com
Date: 2026-11-10T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: PO workflow + consolidated monthly invoices

Hi Ben,

Thanks for the demo last week — the team is excited to move forward. Procurement asked me to share BluePeak's invoicing constraints so we can get vendor setup started. Key items are: 

- BluePeak requires a PO (see attached template). PO number must appear on every invoice and on each line item.
- We prefer consolidated monthly invoices (one file per month) with a CSV breakdown by cost center / project.
- Standard payment term is Net45.
- Remit-to: BluePeak AP portal (we can provide portal upload instructions once vendor is created).
- We also need Redwood's W9 and SOW to complete vendor onboarding.

Two questions that procurement flagged: can Redwood accept consolidated invoices with per-line cost center mapping, and will you accept Net45 (we noted your default is Net30)? Also procurement asked whether discounts we discussed require an annual committed spend or if they can be added to the PO as an approved line-item discount.

Attached: BluePeak_PO_Template.pdf

Appreciate a quick confirmation so I can continue vendor onboarding.

Regards,
Kyle
Kyle Morgan
Sr. Procurement Manager, BluePeak Analytics
procurement@bluepeak.com

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
To: Kyle Morgan <kyle.morgan@bluepeak.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-11-11T10:03:00-08:00
Subject: Re: PO workflow + consolidated monthly invoices

Kyle — thanks, and great to hear. Short answers up front: yes on PO & consolidated monthly invoices; Net45 is possible but needs finance onboarding and a signed SOW for discounts tied to commit. Details below.

Attachments I'm sending: Redwood_W9_and_SOW.pdf (W9 + standard SOW).

Billing / PO details we can support:
- We will include the PO number on every invoice and on each invoice line item.
- We can deliver a consolidated monthly invoice (single PDF) plus a supplemental CSV that maps each line to BluePeak cost centers. Please confirm the CSV column format you need (cost_center, project_code, PO_line, amount, start_date, end_date).
- Net45: our standard is Net30, but Finance can approve Net45 for enterprise deals pending vendor onboarding. For Net45 we need the PO + signed SOW before the first invoice.

Discounts / packaging:
- The tiered discounts we quoted are tied to committed monthly spend bands. To honor a discount without an annual commitment, the discount must be pre-approved in writing and included on the PO as a line item. Larger discounts (>=15%) typically require an annual commitment or prepayment.

Next steps I propose:
1) Procurement returns BluePeak_PO_Template.pdf filled with the expected PO number and remit details.
2) Sign the attached SOW via DocuSign (I can send a template).
3) CC Laura (Finance) so she can start vendor setup for Net45.

Looping in Laura to confirm vendor steps and any exceptions: Laura, can you confirm the timeline for vendor code creation and whether Net45 requires any additional approvals for this account size?

Thanks,
Ben
Ben Carter | Account Executive | Redwood Inference
b.carter@redwoodinference.com | +1 (415) 555-0123

From: Alyssa Chen <alyssa.chen@bluepeak.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>, Kyle Morgan <kyle.morgan@bluepeak.com>
Date: 2026-11-12T08:49:00-08:00
Subject: Re: PO workflow + consolidated monthly invoices

Thanks Ben — quick clarifications from procurement: 

- CSV columns: cost_center, department_code, cost_center_description, PO_number, invoice_amount, invoice_date, GL_account. If you can match that layout it would speed reconciliation.
- Vendor portal: we will need the vendor tax name, EIN, and ACH remit-to details. Can you provide bank details after vendor onboarding (we normally don't accept external banking info over email).
- Discounts: Procurement will add the approved discount line on the PO if Redwood confirms the discount % in writing.

We'll fill the PO template and return it by EOD Friday. If Net45 requires any contracts/legal approvals beyond the SOW please flag now so we can route internally.

Alyssa Chen
Procurement Operations, BluePeak Analytics
alyssa.chen@bluepeak.com

From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>, Kyle Morgan <kyle.morgan@bluepeak.com>, Alyssa Chen <alyssa.chen@bluepeak.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-11-18T11:22:00-08:00
Subject: Re: PO workflow + consolidated monthly invoices

Hi all — Laura from Finance. Welcome — we can accommodate BluePeak's requirements with the following steps and caveats: 

1) Vendor setup checklist (documents required): W9 (received), completed vendor onboarding form (we will send), completed ACH form (once vendor code created), and the signed SOW.
2) Net45 approval: For deals under $50k ARR we require Net30. For deals above $50k ARR Finance can approve Net45 after vendor creation and credit review. If you expect the first invoice to exceed $50k, please note that in the PO and we'll fast-track the review.
3) Consolidated invoice format: We can provide a single PDF invoice plus an attached CSV in the exact column format Alyssa listed. Please attach the BluePeak PO number to each line in the CSV.
4) Discounts:
   - Discounts up to 10% can be applied as a PO line-item if explicitly listed.
   - Discounts >10% require an approved sales credit memo and may require a contract amendment (signed SOW + underwriting).

I have attached a sample "Consolidated-Billing-Schedule.xlsx" that shows how we populate cost center mappings. Once the PO template and expected invoicing cadence are confirmed, we will create the vendor code in 3-5 business days.

Attachments: Consolidated-Billing-Schedule.xlsx

If you want, Vivek (cc'd) can provide a short CSV export example from our billing system so you can validate mapping.

Best,
Laura Bennett
Finance Manager, Redwood Inference
laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
To: Kyle Morgan <kyle.morgan@bluepeak.com>, Alyssa Chen <alyssa.chen@bluepeak.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-11-20T15:04:00-08:00
Subject: Re: PO workflow + consolidated monthly invoices — proposed MAP

Thanks everyone — proposed mutual action plan to keep momentum: 

1) BluePeak returns filled PO (BluePeak_PO_Template.pdf) with requested PO number and any discount line items by 2026-11-24.
2) I will send DocuSign for the SOW (based on Redwood_W9_and_SOW.pdf) same day — please sign so Laura can finish vendor onboarding.
3) Laura creates vendor code (3 business days after receiving onboarding form).
4) First consolidated invoice will be generated on the first billing cycle after vendor creation. Redwood will attach the CSV with the columns: cost_center, department_code, cost_center_description, PO_number, invoice_amount, invoice_date, GL_account.

If procurement confirms the PO will include the discount % as a line item, we can honor the discount immediately. If the discount exceeds 10%, our legal team (Marissa cc'd) will need to approve the amendment — Marissa, please confirm the review SLA for a simple amendment (expected <5 business days).

Kyle/Alyssa — I can jump on a 20-minute call tomorrow if that helps finalize the PO details. Otherwise I will wait for your filled PO and signature on the SOW and we will start vendor onboarding.

Thanks,
Ben
Ben Carter | Account Executive | Redwood Inference
Attachments: Redwood_W9_and_SOW.pdf; Consolidated-Billing-Schedule.xlsx
